Hi Priya / EdgeCloud team —

Following up from last week's discovery, attached is the initial MAP (redwood-map-v2.pdf) that captures the evaluation plan, procurement checkpoints, and proposed 8-week close timeline for Cambridge Health Systems. High level:

- Evaluation plan: POC (2 weeks) -> security review (SOC2 evidence) -> pilot (4 weeks) -> procurement sign-off (2 weeks)
- Purchase paths: AWS Marketplace (metered/offers), Azure Marketplace (managed application), and reseller (EdgeCloud) for on-prem/cloud-hybrid procurement
- Key dependencies: marketplace listing approval (Redwood/Cloud marketplace), reseller quoting + redistribution agreement, procurement legal review of contract-draft-v3.docx

Can we confirm the following before Wednesday's checkpoint?
1) Cambridge internal procurement contact for contract redlines (if different from Priya)
2) Whether EdgeCloud will act as the billing entity or only as a reseller introducer
3) Any additional security artifacts needed beyond SOC2 (e.g., data flow diagrams, encryption KMS details)

I'll circulate updated action items after the checkpoint. Proposed weekly cadence: Mondays 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks —
